description: The register half of gate U11 (DR-0003 decision P8): the product non-goals, every catalog tradeoff verbatim, and the one fully populated reference leaf issue. Leaf non-goals stay in each issue body. A product non-goal changes only through the owner; adding a tradeoff with a new catalog entry is additive. The ROUNDS-32 tradeoff names the cutover without "data-preserving", so DR-0001@2 allowlists its line under G11 until the catalog wording changes (spec-change request SCR-1 in docs/program/reauthorization.md).

tradeoffs.text: Ephemeral workers cost more than pooled in-process execution but make isolation reviewable.
Server-owned definitions reduce caller flexibility while removing executable input from the public contract.
One-time bearer disclosure prevents secret recovery and requires an explicit rotation flow.
Uniform public failures reduce support diagnostics but prevent account and artifact enumeration.
Ratification slows immediate feature coding but prevents expensive parallel authorities and naming drift.
Command and projection infrastructure adds explicit ceremony in exchange for one auditable mutation path and bounded consistency.
Separate aggregates add explicit joins but prevent authentication identity from becoming accidental portfolio content.
Identity resolution introduces review work for ambiguous matches but prevents silent destructive deduplication.
Typed constructs require migration and careful extension rules but avoid one unbounded generic content entity.
A relation registry needs governance, but it keeps arbitrary cross-entity links out of page code and free text.
Trusted build-time packs are less dynamic than arbitrary plugins but preserve self-host reliability, accessibility, security, and migration control.
Shared primitives reduce inconsistency, while keeping page composition explicit avoids generic form-builder experiences.
A durable inbox adds an intermediate step for rich sources but prevents hidden imports and lost partial work.
Preserving raw sources improves auditability but requires explicit retention, deletion, encryption, and backup-expiry policy.
Visible claims require review UI and storage, but they make automation correctable and preserve user trust.
Atomic review may defer some accepted fields until conflicts resolve, but avoids a half-imported career history.
Source-specific adapters cost more than a generic text importer but preserve native fields and honest source limitations.
Explicit invocation and retention controls add friction but make provider use auditable and self-hosting choices meaningful.
Explicit editions and revisions add concepts, but remove confusing detach and synchronization behavior while making submissions reproducible.
Removing push-back from material to profile requires an explicit separate profile-edit action, which makes authority clearer.
Immutable submission records consume storage but eliminate uncertainty about which changing draft was sent.
Complete portability requires versioned schemas and upgrade tooling beyond simple JSON Resume compatibility.
Separating posting and pursuit adds a relation but prevents source refresh from rewriting personal history.
A governed registry constrains ad hoc custom statuses but supports pack extensions through explicit versioned contracts.
A continuous workspace requires careful progressive disclosure to avoid overwhelming users with every lifecycle tool at once.
Structured stages require more modeling than a list, but enable consistent preparation, history, scheduling, and pack-specific process types.
Structured relationship context should remain lightweight and never become an invasive CRM or automatic surveillance system.
Structured compensation cannot capture every term, so the model needs typed common fields plus private extensible terms and source evidence.
Query lenses may change membership over time, so historical reports need explicit snapshots rather than copied live records.
Typed relations should supplement readable action text, not turn quick capture into a mandatory project-management form.
A universal surface must remain predictable: explicit modes and previews are preferable to opaque natural-language action guessing.
Shared contracts unify durable meaning, while track-specific payloads and components preserve the specialized practice experience.
Recommendations should optimize user attention without pretending readiness is an objective hiring probability.
A strong priority queue must remain user-correctable and avoid gamified urgency or opaque productivity scoring.
Read models introduce eventual consistency, so freshness and command-to-read expectations must be explicit and visible.
A clean cutover requires deliberate gates and temporary adapters but avoids permanently paying for dual writes and reconciliation.
Consistency should govern behavior and primitives without flattening distinct workspaces into one generic card grid.
End-to-end release proof costs compute and maintenance, but prevents architecture claims from outrunning exercised behavior.

referenceLeaf.rule: Gate U11's one fully populated reference leaf issue. Default taken under the owner's delegation (DR-0003 decision P9): #18, the refinement's suggestion. The owner designates another by superseding DR-0003.
